user.title: Configure Liquipedia
user.description: Choose a game to load its ongoing tournaments and those starting in the next 30 days.

tournament.title: Choose a tournament
tournament.description: Select a tournament in progress or starting in the next 30 days. If yours is missing, choose manual entry.

manual.title: Enter a match schedule
manual.description: Enter the Match Schedule page title from Liquipedia, for example: First Stand Tournament/2026/Match Schedule.

error.invalid_tournament: Select a tournament from the list.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to load Liquipedia data. Try again or choose manual entry.
error.no_tournaments: No tournaments were found in this period. You can enter a schedule manually.
error.no_schedule: No supported match schedule was found. Choose another tournament or enter its schedule manually.

abort.already_configured: This game and tournament are already configured.
